title: Function sum and support cardinality
statement: Let $f$ be a function from the binary cube of dimension $n$ to $\\mathbb F_2$. The sum of $f$ over all inputs equals, in $\\mathbb F_2$, the cardinality of the set of inputs on which $f$ equals $1$.
hypotheses_covered: An $\\mathbb F_2$-valued function on the binary cube of dimension $n$
